title: Actual Q3 local-energy four-leg D(t) audit
question: Does replacing the global shifted total-energy weight by the positive local edge-energy weight keep the four D(t) weighted legs finite and less volume-sensitive on the actual Q3 histories?
method: Build the registered edge, square, and six-site 2x3 Q3 Hamiltonians with oscillator dimension three, beta in {0.5,1,2}, radii {0.5,1}, time 0.05 and both cutoff orientations.
Form D_sigma(t) from the actual full and cutoff Hamiltonian unitaries and compute all four matrix-product legs with the positive local edge weight K_X and the full shifted Hamiltonian weight K_full.
Reconstruct the same local and full legs independently from trace identities Tr(rho D* K^2 D), Tr(rho D K^2 D*), Tr(rho K D*D K), and Tr(rho K DD* K), without inserting rho^(1/2).
Compile Lean R317 for the scalar four-leg regrouping and exact local/global fixture arithmetic; keep all uniformity and common-core gates explicit.
finding: Primary 105/105, independent 77/77, integrated 13/13 and Lean R317 PASS over 36 actual-Q3 rows. The local-weight maximum four-leg sums for volumes 2,4,6 are respectively (1.5582388906e-05, 3.5082596819e-05, 4.5493115615e-05) at beta 0.5, (1.7993155369e-05, 5.9350271376e-05, 9.0996077453e-05) at beta 1, and (2.1824228487e-05, 1.0314165594e-04, 1.7439045293e-04) at beta 2. The corresponding full-global maxima reach 7.0936355473e-04. The finite local-volume ratio is 11.1915 versus 45.5234 for the global baseline. The local weight reduces the measured volume sensitivity but finite growth remains, so no uniform bound is inferred.
decision_reason: EXP-001146 removed the global total-energy topology as a volume-uniform local shortcut. This checkpoint confirms that the actual Q3 finite D(t) history can be evaluated with a noncommuting local edge weight and that the local route is materially less volume-sensitive on the declared grid. Since the local ratio still grows and only three finite volumes are sampled, the correct verdict is an advanced finite interface with the common-core/local-weighted theorem still open.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite actual-Q3 local-weighted D(t) audit. It does not prove a source-, volume-, cutoff-, or beta-uniform estimate, modular-domain transfer, direct D or delta-D Cauchy, product/core density, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.

adversarial_review.check: K_X is treated as a matrix in the full-H representation; no simultaneous diagonalization with rho is assumed.
All four D/D* left/right legs are retained and independently reconstructed by trace formulas.
The local and global volume ratios are finite-grid diagnostics only and are not promoted to divergence or a no-go theorem.
K_full is reported as a baseline, not as an admissible volume-uniform local estimate after EXP-001146.
Common-core local-weighted uniformity, modular transfer, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

next_action: Prove a source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform local/centered K_X four-leg bound for the declared Q3 common core, then transfer it to direct D and delta-D Cauchy with the modular companion. Use the finite local rows only as calibration; do not promote their ratio.

qft_interface.closed: Finite actual-Q3 local-energy four-leg D(t) rows and an independent noncommuting trace reconstruction; local weight is materially less volume-sensitive than global K on the declared grid.
qft_interface.open: Uniform local-weighted common-core estimate, modular transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, products, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
